div.head: Northu 61.2
div.ab: ⁊ gif hit hwa gedo, nabbe he Godes mildse, buton he geswice ⁊ bete, swa biscop getæce.
And gif hit hwa gedo, nabbe he Godes mildse, buton he geswice and bete swa biscop getæce.
And if anyone does so, may he not have God’s mercy, unless he desists and atones as the bishop directs.
And if anyone does so, let him not have God's mercy, unless he desists and repents as the bishop instructs.
Und wenn es einer thut, erhalte er nicht Gottes Gnade, wenn er nicht ablässt und büsst, wie der Bischof vorschreibt.
And if anyone does it, let him not have God's mercy, unless he desists and atones as the bishop directs.
div.note: U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘and if anyone does so, may he not have God's mercy, unless he desists and atones as the bishop directs.’).
